import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Handle 'Sleep Disorder' NaN values by replacing them with 'None'
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')

# Create the scatter plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',  # Color points based on Sleep Disorder status
    size='Stress Level',   # Size points based on Stress Level
    sizes=(50, 400),       # Define the range of marker sizes
    alpha=0.7,             # Set transparency for better visibility of overlapping points
    palette='tab10'        # Choose a distinct color palette for categorical hue
)

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Relationship Between Sleep Duration, Quality, Stress, and Sleep Disorders', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (Hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10 Scale)', fontsize=12)

# Improve legend placement and title
plt.legend(title='Legend', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# Add grid for readability
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels/legend from being cut off
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
